snippet.title: AUesportsleague
snippet.description:
Australian Esports League (AEL) founded in 2016 with the vision of providing access to esports at all levels across Australia and elevating competition to the next level! We focus on players and community with our programs & events supporting grass root activities across Australia and the Oceanic region.

AEL is known for having televised professional leagues, building communities at High Schools, Universities and across Australia, and for being the home of Australia's esports communities.

Website & Social Network
https://ael.org.au/
https://www.facebook.com/AUesportsleague/
https://twitter.com/auesportsleague
https://www.instagram.com/auesportsleague/

Discord Servers 
AEL Discord - https://discord.gg/JMRFXRF
AEL University League - https://discord.gg/jHQKRBY
